dataset: Original synthetic incidents and Harborline code. No personal information.

incidents.title: Carrier retry marked the same parcel delivered twice
incidents.excerpt: On 12 March the west hub received the carrier webhook for parcel HBL-44021 twice, 90 seconds apart, because the first acknowledgement timed out. `confirm_delivery` appended the event a second time, so the parcel showed two delivery scans.

open_siblings.reason: Assigns .status and never checks applied_events or already_applied.
open_siblings.recommended_change: Return early when event_id is already in parcel.applied_events, record the id, then assign status. Match confirm_delivery.

incidents.title: A naive clock marked an on-time parcel late
incidents.excerpt: A parcel scanned at 18:10 in a hub seven hours behind UTC was compared with `datetime.now()` and no timezone. The naive clock treated the instant as late while the parcel was still inside its promise window.

open_siblings.recommended_change: Call datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead of datetime.now() with no argument. Match hub_intake_deadline.

incidents.title: A label was printed for a parcel that was on no manifest
incidents.excerpt: The manifest service returned an error after the label write had already landed. Dock staff applied a label for parcel HBL-44021, and that parcel was on no truck.

open_siblings.reason: Calls write_label, write_manifest with no unit_of_work and no compensating except.
open_siblings.recommended_change: Wrap the writes in with store.unit_of_work(), as print_outbound_label does, so a failed later write rolls the earlier one back.
